news.body:
## Both of these are waiting on you
- The Bain fellowship closes on Sunday.
Four days left and the card on the board is still unanswered. If you are not applying, rejecting it clears it off the list - either way this is a decision rather than a task.
- The KITAS cancellation is three days past its date.
Nothing has moved since Jishnu told Ascentium on the 20th that he would update them on the unpaid sales order. - Your last working day is 6 December, and chasing a Locus payment gets harder once you are off the payroll.
